author: GamingBolt
description:
World domination wasn't on the original manifesto of Umbrella, however. It began with simple curiosity. Let's start with Oswell E. Spencer, born into a wealthy family. While he sought pleasure in collecting priceless art and hunting, his studies revolved around Eugenics and literature, specifically the Natural History Conspectus by Henry Travis. His interest in the encyclopedia would fundamentally change his life. Not that he knew it.

Instead, it was World War 2 that seemingly impacted Spencer's life the most. Following its resolution, he entered university for further studies, and that marked his first encounter with Ashford and Marcus.
title: The Complete Umbrella Timeline - Part 1 - Resident Evil Lore - Before You Play Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's funny how time can warp your perception of a character. There's that bit about the flow always being cruel, and how the thing that doesn't change is “memories of younger days.” But when I remember my first time playing Resident Evil 2, a more unsure, inexperienced and easily rattled Leon comes to mind. 

When I look back at it now, I see a rookie who doesn't know what to do, trapped in a moment that he seemingly can't get out of, but still playing the determined hero. “Someone with weaknesses,” as creative director Hideki Kamiya described him.
title: Leon Is A Beast in Resident Evil Requiem, And I'm Loving It
